mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and temperatures near 45 degrees at Verona Community Park, all under the glow of a full moon.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking public input on the US 18/151 corridor study, with meetings scheduled for November 18th in Mount Horeb and November 19th online to discuss design concepts.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga and more trivia tomorrow, and Verona's main street trick-or-treat event this Wednesday.
In our weekly look at service calls, on October 25th, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped for 20 minutes and subsequently arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Chocolate Caramel Twist, as they open today at 10:00 AM.
